Hi all,

Thanks for the details, Ava. From an accounting perspective we recommend the following standardized treatment so CloudCart can reconcile cleanly: 

1) Create a credit memo (CM-00047) that is applied to the next invoice run. 
   - Reference: Deal DC-1849 / Promo CC-TRIAL-2026
   - Description field should match: "Promotional trial credit — evaluation May 27–Jun 13, 2026"
2) Book the credit as contra-revenue (account code 4200-PRM) rather than as a cash refund — this preserves AR aging for the invoice cycle.
3) No VAT impact expected for this promotional credit in the US jurisdiction; if CloudCart has non-US entities we will evaluate tax.
4) Evidence package: we will provide a one-page accounting note (see attached acct_note_cloudcart.txt) and the signed promo approval (attached by Sales).

One procedural ask: any promotional credit > $25,000 requires written approval from Sales leadership for internal control. Karthik, please confirm approval for the amount ($32,450) so we can post.

If CloudCart prefers a negative line on the invoice rather than a separate credit memo, we can do that — outcome is the same for your P&L; preference matters for your internal reconciliation.
